articles.title: Fidelity Collapses with Table Size, Not Turn Count: Delivery Architecture in a Deployed Tool-Using Agent

draft.overview: 评估多轮筛选中让结果表绕过模型、从会话状态直接交付的收益
draft.reason: 同样筛选下午起飞的航班，结果表从 5 行增至 100 行，Gemini 2.5 Flash 转述结果的满分率从 83% 降到 6%。改由工具直接交付结果，这组实验的 93 次运行全部答对。

blocks.body:
作者固定六条航线的查询结果，每次只取表的前若干行。小表就是大表的开头，同一条筛选指令在每个表长、每条航线上各测三次。模型在第一轮筛选就出现了随表长增加而变多的错误。
两条路径的区别在于谁交付记录：一条由模型筛选并重述航班；另一条把记录保存在会话里，由模型给出筛选条件，工具执行后直接返回匹配的行。
blocks.evidence: from 83% at K=5 to 6% at K=100 while BYPASS is perfect in all 93 runs

blocks.body:
直接交付方案同时改了两件事：跨轮保存记录，以及由工具返回结果。实验测到的是两者合起来的收益。
如果你的智能体已经保存了工具结果，可以用同一份记录和筛选条件分别走两条交付路径，逐行核对。这样才能看出，仅换掉最后的转述步骤能挽回多少错误。
blocks.evidence: attributable to the pair, not to either member

localization.reason_en: Asked for the same afternoon flights, Gemini 2.5 Flash earned full credit in 83% of runs with 5 input rows and just 6% with 100. When the tool delivered the matching rows directly, all 93 runs in this experiment earned full credit.
localization.summary_en:
The authors froze the results for six routes and took progressively longer prefixes of each table. Every small table was the start of its larger counterpart. They repeated the same filter three times per route at each shared table size. Errors grew with table size on the very first filter request.
In one setup the model filtered and restated the flights. In the other, the records stayed in session state. The model supplied the filter arguments and a tool returned the matching rows directly.
localization.thinking_en:
Direct delivery changed two things together: records persisted across turns, and the tool delivered the results. The experiment measured their combined benefit.
If your agent already stores tool results, replay the same records and filter arguments through both delivery paths. Comparing rows field by field isolates the errors you could avoid by changing only the final handoff.
localization.image_title_en: Figure 2 · Fidelity as tool results grow
localization.image_caption_en: Each table grows by appending rows to a fixed payload. Across six routes, Flash synthesis falls to 6% fidelity at 100 rows. Direct delivery is correct in all 93 runs. Shading shows 95% Wilson intervals.
localization.image_alt_en: The orange synthesis curve drops as rows are added. The blue direct-delivery curve stays at 100%.

original_image.title: 图 2 · 工具结果表变长时，交付准确率如何变化
original_image.caption: 同一份结果按行扩展。六条航线汇总后，Flash 转述组在 100 行时的准确率降至 6%，直接交付组的 93 次运行均正确。阴影为 95% Wilson 区间。
original_image.alt: 随行数增加，橙色模型转述曲线下降，蓝色直接交付曲线保持在 100%。

draft.overview: 为本地 MCP 服务单独配置可写目录和联网权限
draft.reason: 在 Codex 配置里接入本地 stdio MCP 服务，启动命令默认仍以当前用户的权限运行。OpenAI 用一个记忆服务演示了另一种配置：离线启动，只允许写入 npm 缓存和服务的数据目录。

blocks.body:
示例先创建记忆服务的数据目录，把固定版本的 npm 包存入缓存。接着用专用权限配置启动服务，让它从缓存加载依赖。
文件与网络限制会由子进程继承。这样即使服务通过 npx 启动，也能在禁网时读到所需的包，并在指定目录保存记忆。
blocks.evidence: without network access, with writes limited to the npm cache and the server’s data directory

blocks.body:
Codex 无法从启动命令推断服务实际需要哪些文件或网络资源。同样能离线启动的两个服务，执行工具调用时可能需要不同的权限。
配置自己的服务时，可以分开验证启动和一次典型调用。若只有调用失败，再核对它需要的目录或域名，比直接给整个服务放宽权限更有针对性。
blocks.evidence: Codex cannot reliably infer which files or network services that server needs

localization.reason_en: A local stdio MCP server configured in Codex starts with the permissions of the user running Codex. OpenAI shows how to start a memory server offline and limit its writes to the npm cache and its own data directory.
localization.summary_en:
The example creates a data directory, caches a pinned npm package, and then starts the memory server under a dedicated permission profile so it can load the dependency locally.
Child processes inherit the filesystem and network restrictions. Even when launched through npx, the server can read its cached package with networking disabled and save memories in the designated directory.
localization.thinking_en:
Codex cannot infer which files or network services a server needs from its launch command. Two servers that start offline may still need different permissions when a tool is called.
Test startup and one typical call separately. If only the call fails, identify the directory or domain it needs before relaxing permissions for the whole server.
localization.image_title_en: How Codex applies a permission profile to a command
localization.image_caption_en: Codex launches the command under the session’s permission profile. Child processes inherit the sandbox restrictions. When enabled, the network proxy enforces domain rules.
localization.image_alt_en: Flow diagram showing how configuration and managed requirements define the session’s permission profile. Codex uses the profile to launch a command in a sandbox on macOS, Linux, or Windows. Child processes inherit the restrictions, and an optional network proxy filters requests by domain.

original_image.title: Codex 如何把权限配置应用到命令
original_image.caption: Codex 按会话权限配置启动命令，子进程继承沙箱限制。启用网络代理时，由代理执行域名规则。
original_image.alt: 流程图中，配置和管理员设定的约束共同确定会话权限配置。Codex 据此在 macOS、Linux 或 Windows 的沙箱中启动命令。子进程继承限制，可选的网络代理按域名规则筛选请求。

articles.title: Building Evidence-Grounded Agent Memory with OpenWiki and Graphs

draft.overview: 评估跨文档问答何时值得编译维基并接入证据图
draft.reason: 给智能体加一份维基，值不值取决于问题。在合成保险文档上，单段查找用关键词搜索同样准、还更快；遇到需要串联多份文档的问题，维基把准确性得分从 0.10 提到 0.52（满分 1）。

blocks.body:
作者固定模型、指令和 111 份文档，把问题分成 80 道单段查找题和 50 道跨文档题，每题问三次，分别看答案得分和引用段落的重合度。
维基能帮智能体串起分散的条款，但同一道题可能引出不同依据。作者把维基中的陈述连到原文段落；在跨文档题上，得分从 0.52 升至 0.66，三次回答的引用重合度翻倍。

文中的每题成本只算检索与作答。最初编译 111 份文档另花了 4.15 美元，后来每新增一份约花 0.09 美元。
如果知识库更新频繁，可以按真实比例回放查找题和跨文档题，再把维护费用摊到每道答对的题上。这才是决定要不要长期维护维基的成本。
blocks.evidence: The analysis below excludes compilation and update costs

localization.reason_en: A wiki helped when an agent had to connect insurance documents. On synthetic policies, single-passage lookups were about as accurate and faster with keyword search. On cross-document questions, the wiki raised the accuracy score from 0.10 to 0.52 out of 1.
localization.summary_en:
The authors held the model, instructions and 111 documents constant. They asked 80 single-passage questions and 50 cross-document questions three times each, scoring answers and measuring how often the same passages were cited.
The wiki helped connect scattered provisions, but answers to the same question could cite different evidence. Linking wiki claims to source paragraphs raised the cross-document score from 0.52 to 0.66 and doubled citation overlap across runs.
localization.thinking_en:
The reported cost per answer covered retrieval and answering. Compiling the initial 111 documents cost another $4.15, and each document added later cost about $0.09.
For a frequently updated collection, replay the actual mix of lookups and cross-document questions. Allocate maintenance costs across correct answers before deciding whether the wiki is worth keeping.
localization.image_title_en: Three memory setups on cross-document questions
localization.image_caption_en: Moving from the wiki alone to a wiki with an evidence graph raised accuracy from 0.52 to 0.66 and cut median answer time from 30 to 18 seconds in the authors’ evaluation.
localization.image_alt_en: Four charts compare accuracy, citation consistency, cost per correct answer, and median latency with search alone, a wiki, or a wiki plus an evidence graph.

original_image.title: 三种记忆方案怎样回答跨文档查询
original_image.caption: 作者比较了三种方案。从单用 wiki 到加入证据图，正确率从 0.52 升到 0.66，中位回答时间从 30 秒降到 18 秒。
original_image.alt: 原文四幅柱状图比较仅搜索、只用 wiki 及 wiki 加证据图的正确率、引用一致性、每个正确回答的成本和中位回答时间。
